about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Sport P460e ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover Sport P460e is a plug-in hybrid variant introduced on the L461 generation from 2022. It combines a 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine with an electric motor, delivering 460PS of combined output. The P460e shares its AJ300 powertrain architecture with the P440e PHEV variant, with a higher power tune. As the L461-generation Range Rover Sport continues in production, the P460e remains a current variant across the latest model years.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ300 PHEV engines for every Range Rover Sport P460e on the road.

compatibility.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover Sport P460e ENGINE
compatibility.intro: The P460e uses the AJ300 PHEV powertrain — a 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine paired with an electric motor and battery pack. Because the PHEV system integrates engine and electric drivetrain components, compatibility is specific to the L461 chassis generation. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (AJ300 PHEV) via registration or VIN
Whether your build falls in the early production period (2019-2020) for injector fault coverage

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Defender quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
